definition: Fixed 2019–2021 national RES employment-weighted THAIE quintiles, not re-ranked within sex or age
score_benchmark: GPT-5 2025, existing corrected KSCO8 manuscript scores
membership: KECO2025 exact normalized official label; all KSCO8 targets must have the same original quintile; no allocation weights
cohort: Within each age, identical occupation cohort for both sexes, observed in every one of 35 months, positive November2022 counts
selection: Eligibility uses full displayed-window completeness; descriptive selected cohort, not national causal inference
missing: No zero imputation, no time interpolation; explicit observed zero counts retained
total: Sum of included Q1–Q5 occupation cohorts, not all nationally insured persons
source: Employment administration official occupation-age-sex aggregates; KEIS KECO2025–KSCO8 official appendix pp659–682 (PDF pages663–686)
